phase: Residual characterization; no vault result claim by Worker.

params.p_value_formula: (r + 1) / (n + 1), with n recorded as pvalue_null_draws per cell

pre_launch_estimate.note: Primary median-pdist B=1000 cells dominate; max/mean B=50 cells add robustness coverage.

decision_branch.rule: Residual is robust only if the median-pdist B=1000 dual-metric cell rejects at p<0.01 and at least two of median/max/mean-pdist have same-direction birth/death shifts with dual-metric rejection; sign flips trigger non-robust classification.

embedding_dependence.reason: Legacy embeddings and the 2026-05-02 L=1000 H2 result are present, but no serialized pre-refreeze scaler/PCA model was found. A fair Markov-null rerun would need that model to transform synthetic trajectories through the same coordinate system; refitting PCA per draw would reproduce the old unfrozen bug rather than a representation-robustness cell.
embedding_dependence.caveat: The committed characterization result should be read as current frozen-representation evidence; the pre-refreeze discrepancy remains a representation-robustness caveat.

stratification.method: Band-restricted W2 diagnostic: recompute H2 W2 after filtering both diagrams by persistence band; shares are descriptive and not an exact optimal-transport cost decomposition.
